errors.description: mac_stats_q is a multi-bit value produced in rxmac_clk and sampled directly in csr_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
rx_good_pulse_q is a one-cycle rxmac_clk pulse consumed directly in csr_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
rx_good_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample csr_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in csr_event_o.
stat_sel_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector stat_sel_q before decoding in csr_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
rxmac_rst_n is used as data inside csr_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
txmac_snapshot_q combines rxmac_clk payload state with csr_clk status state in txmac_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
